{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows
display(sales_df.head())

# Display data types and missing values
print(sales_df.info())

# Check for duplicates
print(f"Number of duplicate rows: {sales_df.duplicated().sum()}")

# Check the unique values in the 'channel' column
print(f"Unique channels: {sales_df['channel'].unique()}")

# Check the 'converted' column for binary values
print(f"Unique values in 'converted': {sales_df['converted'].unique()}")

# Check the distribution of channel and converted
print(sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].agg(['count', 'mean']))"}
